description: Monstera with widespread lower leaf yellowing — overwatering symptom
expected_assessment: Multiple lower leaves exhibit solid bright yellow discoloration simultaneously, characteristic of prolonged soil moisture. Upper canopy remains healthy green. Pattern is consistent with overwatering stress affecting the oldest foliage first.
actual_assessment: Lower leaves near the soil line show uniform yellowing, suggesting the root zone has been consistently wet. The newer growth at the top appears unaffected, indicating early-stage overwatering symptoms.

description: Peace lily with severe wilting and limp leaves — water deficit
expected_assessment: The entire canopy droops significantly with stems losing structural rigidity. Leaves hang limply rather than standing outward. This is consistent with severe dehydration where the root zone has become completely dry.
actual_assessment: Plant shows dramatic wilting with all leaves drooping downward over the pot rim. Foliage lacks turgor pressure. The condition indicates critical water deficit throughout the root zone.

description: Calathea with crispy brown leaf edges — low humidity
expected_assessment: Leaf margins and tips show dry, brittle browning with characteristic yellow transition zone. The interior leaf tissue remains green, indicating the damage is humidity-related rather than systemic. Pattern consistent with low ambient humidity stress.
actual_assessment: Brown crispy edges observed along leaf margins, particularly on older leaves. A narrow yellow band separates damaged edges from the green center. Consistent with dry air conditions typical of indoor heating.

description: Peace lily healthy — no symptoms detected
expected_assessment: All leaves appear uniformly deep green with no discoloration. Foliage stands upright with good turgor. No visible signs of overwatering or nutrient deficiency detected. Plant appears in excellent health.
actual_assessment: The plant displays consistent dark green coloring across all foliage. Leaves are erect and well-hydrated. No yellowing, browning, or wilting symptoms are present. Overall health status is good.

description: Pothos with pale faded leaves and scorch marks — excess light
expected_assessment: Upper leaves facing the window show bleached, pale yellowish-green coloration with distinct dry brown scorch patches. Lower and shaded leaves remain their normal green. Damage pattern indicates direct sunlight exposure burning the foliage.
actual_assessment: Light-facing foliage appears washed out and faded compared to shaded leaves. Brown papery marks visible on the most exposed leaves. Symptoms are consistent with sun scorch from excessive direct light exposure.
